jdbcQuery.query: SELECT q.bill_cycle_code,q.account_id,q.service_agreement_id,q.premise_id,q.bill_id,q.bill_segment_id,q.bill_date,q.bill_create_date,q.bseg_create_date,q.bill_status_description,q.bseg_status_description,q.is_error_sw,q.error_reason,q.exception_type,q.recommended_action,q.event_date,q.most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM (WITH bill_day_volume AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') AS bill_cycle_code,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) AS event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT b.acct_id) AS acct_count,COUNT(DISTINCT b.bill_id) AS bill_count FROM cisadm.ci_bill b LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), ''),TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm))), cycle_anchor AS (SELECT bill_cycle_code,event_date AS cycle_anchor_date FROM (SELECT bdv.bill_cycle_code,bdv.event_date,bdv.acct_count,bdv.bill_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bdv.bill_cycle_code ORDER BY bdv.acct_count DESC, bdv.bill_count DESC, bdv.event_date DESC) AS rn FROM bill_day_volume bdv) WHERE rn = 1), expected_active AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') AS bill_cycle_code,sa.acct_id,sa.sa_id FROM cisadm.ci_sa sa JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = sa.acct_id WHERE TRIM(sa.sa_status_flg) = '20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') IS NOT NULL), bill_status_lookup AS (SELECT field_value AS status_code,MAX(descr) AS status_description FROM cisadm.ci_lookup_val_l WHERE field_name = 'BILL_STAT_FLG' AND language_cd = 'ENG' GROUP BY field_value), bseg_status_lookup AS (SELECT field_value AS status_code,MAX(descr) AS status_description FROM cisadm.ci_lookup_val_l WHERE field_name = 'BSEG_STAT_FLG' AND language_cd = 'ENG' GROUP BY field_value), anchor_bill_headers AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,h.account_id,h.bill_id,h.bill_date,h.bill_create_date,NVL(bsl.status_description,'BILL_STATUS_' || h.bill_stat_flg) AS bill_status_description,ca.cycle_anchor_date AS event_date FROM cycle_anchor ca JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') AS bill_cycle_code,b.acct_id AS account_id,b.bill_id,b.bill_stat_flg,TRUNC(b.bill_dt) AS bill_date,TRUNC(b.cre_dttm) AS bill_create_date,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) AS event_date FROM cisadm.ci_bill b LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1) h ON h.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code AND h.event_date = ca.cycle_anchor_date LEFT JOIN bill_status_lookup bsl ON bsl.status_code = h.bill_stat_flg), anchor_segments AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,sq.account_id,sq.service_agreement_id,sq.premise_id,sq.bill_id,sq.bill_segment_id,sq.bill_date,sq.bill_create_date,sq.bseg_create_date,NVL(bsl.status_description,'BILL_STATUS_' || sq.bill_stat_flg) AS bill_status_description,NVL(ssl.status_description,'BSEG_STATUS_' || sq.bseg_stat_flg) AS bseg_status_description,ca.cycle_anchor_date AS event_date FROM cycle_anchor ca JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(s.bill_cyc_cd, NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd))), '') AS bill_cycle_code,NVL(b.acct_id, sa.acct_id) AS account_id,s.sa_id AS service_agreement_id,s.prem_id AS premise_id,s.bill_id,s.bseg_id AS bill_segment_id,b.bill_stat_flg,s.bseg_stat_flg,TRUNC(b.bill_dt) AS bill_date,TRUNC(b.cre_dttm) AS bill_create_date,TRUNC(s.cre_dttm) AS bseg_create_date,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm)) AS event_date FROM cisadm.ci_bseg s LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_bill b ON b.bill_id = s.bill_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_sa sa ON sa.sa_id = s.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = NVL(b.acct_id, sa.acct_id) WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(s.bill_cyc_cd, NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd))), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1) sq ON sq.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code AND sq.event_date = ca.cycle_anchor_date LEFT JOIN bill_status_lookup bsl ON bsl.status_code = sq.bill_stat_flg LEFT JOIN bseg_status_lookup ssl ON ssl.status_code = sq.bseg_stat_flg) SELECT d.bill_cycle_code,d.account_id,d.service_agreement_id,d.premise_id,d.bill_id,d.bill_segment_id,d.bill_date,d.bill_create_date,d.bseg_create_date,d.bill_status_description,d.bseg_status_description,'Y' AS is_error_sw,d.error_reason,d.exception_type,d.recommended_action,d.event_date,'Y' AS most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM (SELECT ea.bill_cycle_code,ea.acct_id AS account_id,ea.sa_id AS service_agreement_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS premise_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_segment_id,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bill_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bill_create_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bseg_create_date,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bill_status_description,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bseg_status_description,'Active service agreement is assigned to the cycle but no bill header appears in the anchored cycle snapshot.' AS error_reason,'MISSING_EXPECTED_BILL' AS exception_type,'Review account billing completion and batch outcome for the anchored cycle run.' AS recommended_action,ca.cycle_anchor_date AS event_date FROM expected_active ea JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = ea.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN anchor_bill_headers abh ON abh.bill_cycle_code = ea.bill_cycle_code AND abh.account_id = ea.acct_id WHERE abh.account_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT abh.bill_cycle_code,abh.account_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS service_agreement_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS premise_id,abh.bill_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_segment_id,abh.bill_date,abh.bill_create_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bseg_create_date,abh.bill_status_description,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bseg_status_description,'Bill header exists in the anchored cycle snapshot but no bill segment row is linked to that bill.' AS error_reason,'MISSING_BSEG' AS exception_type,'Review bill segment generation and confirm the bill completed with segment output.' AS recommended_action,abh.event_date FROM anchor_bill_headers abh LEFT JOIN anchor_segments aseg ON aseg.bill_cycle_code = abh.bill_cycle_code AND aseg.bill_id = abh.bill_id WHERE aseg.bill_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT aseg.bill_cycle_code,aseg.account_id,aseg.service_agreement_id,aseg.premise_id,aseg.bill_id,aseg.bill_segment_id,aseg.bill_date,aseg.bill_create_date,aseg.bseg_create_date,aseg.bill_status_description,aseg.bseg_status_description,'Bill segment row exists in the anchored cycle snapshot but no matching bill header is present.' AS error_reason,'ORPHAN_BSEG' AS exception_type,'Review bill header creation and confirm the segment is attached to the correct bill.' AS recommended_action,aseg.event_date FROM anchor_segments aseg LEFT JOIN anchor_bill_headers abh ON abh.bill_cycle_code = aseg.bill_cycle_code AND abh.bill_id = aseg.bill_id WHERE abh.bill_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT abh.bill_cycle_code,abh.account_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS service_agreement_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS premise_id,abh.bill_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_segment_id,abh.bill_date,abh.bill_create_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bseg_create_date,abh.bill_status_description,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bseg_status_description,'Bill status indicates an exception condition in the anchored cycle snapshot.' AS error_reason,'BILL_STATUS_EXCEPTION' AS exception_type,'Review bill status and billing batch logs for the affected bill.' AS recommended_action,abh.event_date FROM anchor_bill_headers abh WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(NVL(abh.bill_status_description,'')),'ERROR|EXCEPTION|FAIL') UNION ALL SELECT aseg.bill_cycle_code,aseg.account_id,aseg.service_agreement_id,aseg.premise_id,aseg.bill_id,aseg.bill_segment_id,aseg.bill_date,aseg.bill_create_date,aseg.bseg_create_date,aseg.bill_status_description,aseg.bseg_status_description,'Bill segment status indicates an exception condition in the anchored cycle snapshot.' AS error_reason,'BSEG_STATUS_EXCEPTION' AS exception_type,'Review bill segment status and the billing batch or retry path for the segment.' AS recommended_action,aseg.event_date FROM anchor_segments aseg WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(NVL(aseg.bseg_status_description,'')),'ERROR|EXCEPTION|FAIL')) d) q

SELECT q.bill_cycle_code,q.bill_cycle_description,q.expected_active_sa_count,q.expected_active_account_count,q.actual_billed_sa_count,q.actual_billed_account_count,q.actual_bill_segment_count,q.actual_bill_count,q.missing_active_sa_count,q.missing_active_account_count,q.cycle_last_event_date,q.most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM (WITH bill_day_volume AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') AS bill_cycle_code,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) AS event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT b.acct_id) AS acct_count,COUNT(DISTINCT b.bill_id) AS bill_count FROM cisadm.ci_bill b LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), ''),TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm))), cycle_anchor AS (SELECT bill_cycle_code,event_date AS cycle_last_event_date FROM (SELECT bdv.bill_cycle_code,bdv.event_date,bdv.acct_count,bdv.bill_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bdv.bill_cycle_code ORDER BY bdv.acct_count DESC, bdv.bill_count DESC, bdv.event_date DESC) AS rn FROM bill_day_volume bdv) WHERE rn = 1), cycle_catalog AS (SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') AS bill_cycle_code FROM cisadm.ci_sa sa JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = sa.acct_id WHERE TRIM(sa.sa_status_flg) = '20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT bill_cycle_code FROM cycle_anchor), expected_counts AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') AS bill_cycle_code,COUNT(DISTINCT sa.sa_id) AS expected_active_sa_count,COUNT(DISTINCT sa.acct_id) AS expected_active_account_count FROM cisadm.ci_sa sa JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = sa.acct_id WHERE TRIM(sa.sa_status_flg) = '20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '')), anchor_bill_header_counts AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,COUNT(DISTINCT b.bill_id) AS actual_bill_count,COUNT(DISTINCT b.acct_id) AS actual_billed_account_count FROM cycle_anchor ca JOIN cisadm.ci_bill b ON TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) = ca.cycle_last_event_date LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') = ca.bill_cycle_code AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY ca.bill_cycle_code), anchor_segment_counts AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,COUNT(DISTINCT seg.bseg_id) AS actual_bill_segment_count,COUNT(DISTINCT seg.sa_id) AS actual_billed_sa_count FROM cycle_anchor ca JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(s.bill_cyc_cd, NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd))), '') AS bill_cycle_code,s.sa_id,s.bseg_id,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm)) AS event_date FROM cisadm.ci_bseg s LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_bill b ON b.bill_id = s.bill_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_sa sa ON sa.sa_id = s.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = NVL(b.acct_id, sa.acct_id) WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(s.bill_cyc_cd, NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd))), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, s.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1) seg ON seg.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code AND seg.event_date = ca.cycle_last_event_date GROUP BY ca.bill_cycle_code), actual_counts AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,ca.cycle_last_event_date,NVL(ascs.actual_billed_sa_count,0) AS actual_billed_sa_count,NVL(abhc.actual_billed_account_count,0) AS actual_billed_account_count,NVL(ascs.actual_bill_segment_count,0) AS actual_bill_segment_count,NVL(abhc.actual_bill_count,0) AS actual_bill_count FROM cycle_anchor ca LEFT JOIN anchor_bill_header_counts abhc ON abhc.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN anchor_segment_counts ascs ON ascs.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code), cycle_desc AS (SELECT TRIM(bill_cyc_cd) AS bill_cycle_code,MAX(descr) AS bill_cycle_description FROM cisadm.ci_bill_cyc_l WHERE language_cd IN ('ENG','EN') GROUP BY TRIM(bill_cyc_cd)) SELECT c.bill_cycle_code,NVL(d.bill_cycle_description,'Cycle ' || c.bill_cycle_code) AS bill_cycle_description,NVL(e.expected_active_sa_count,0) AS expected_active_sa_count,NVL(e.expected_active_account_count,0) AS expected_active_account_count,NVL(a.actual_billed_sa_count,0) AS actual_billed_sa_count,NVL(a.actual_billed_account_count,0) AS actual_billed_account_count,NVL(a.actual_bill_segment_count,0) AS actual_bill_segment_count,NVL(a.actual_bill_count,0) AS actual_bill_count,GREATEST(NVL(e.expected_active_sa_count,0)-NVL(a.actual_billed_sa_count,0),0) AS missing_active_sa_count,GREATEST(NVL(e.expected_active_account_count,0)-NVL(a.actual_billed_account_count,0),0) AS missing_active_account_count,a.cycle_last_event_date,CASE WHEN a.cycle_last_event_date = MAX(a.cycle_last_event_date) OVER () THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM cycle_catalog c LEFT JOIN expected_counts e ON e.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN actual_counts a ON a.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN cycle_desc d ON d.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code WHERE c.bill_cycle_code IS NOT NULL) q
